claim: Reasonable steady-state photopic receptor-reference renderer; not a complete anatomical eye, local image-appearance model, or medical observer model.

spectralObserver.nativeBinWeighting: exact integral of the piecewise-linear fundamental over each native wavelength-bin interval
spectralObserver.nonlinearityOrdering: integrate the complete spectrum into LMS before any nonlinear response

absoluteNormalization.receptorUnits: D65-equivalent candelas per square meter after channel normalization
absoluteNormalization.normalizationRule: Invert the declared LMS-to-XYZ_F matrix at D65; scale each LMS channel so that the declared D65 white with Y=100 has equal normalized receptor coordinates of 100.
absoluteNormalization.displayInterpretation: The same inverse normalization and LMS-to-XYZ_F matrix maps normalized receptor responses to the declared D65 display. Rec.709 containment remains a separately observable display operation.

globalAdaptation.input: accepted global L_A from visible direct spectral E_v / pi
globalAdaptation.scope: one condition-wide scalar; steady-state photopic; no spatial or temporal adaptation

primaryResponse.exponentProvenance: Valeton and van Norren 1983 primate foveal cone response fit

halfSaturation.role: Declared standardized appearance placement from CAM16, not an anatomical cone-isomerization constant.

diagnosticResponseCrossings.role: Reported operating-range crossings only; they do not clip the response.

controls.role: Verified standardized appearance-response control; not interchangeable with CIE 2006 LMS.
Projection and hue diagnostic without response compression.

explicitExclusions: pupil dynamics and retinal illuminance in trolands
glare, bloom, and optical point spread
